description: Capture and organize your knowledge for fast recall—right on cue.

interface.shortDescription: Capture and organize your knowledge for fast recall—right on cue.
interface.longDescription: Collect selected parts of Codex and Claude sessions as private evidence, then turn reviewed sources into clear, searchable Markdown. Capture decisions, meeting summaries, tasks and knowledge-base notes with independent collection and processing controls. Direct saves are also supported.
defaultPrompt: Set up Cuefluent Notes for this project.
